bible.title: The Hairpin of Gullwheel
bible.kernel: A patron hires the company to fetch Trustram Greyfell alive from the Western Forests. A bloodied hairpin points to a windmill, the miller brings the matter to the warden-stones, and the company must settle the exchange there.

cast.name: Irvsie Duskbough
cast.who: A ridge widow who holds local pledges and hires muscle to keep her claim.
cast.want: to have Trustram Greyfell handed over alive at the warden-stones

cast.name: Garalo
cast.who: A miller with flour on his hands and a scar down one cheek, used to bargaining for people and grain.
cast.want: to hide Trustram in Thornhollow and keep him from being taken

cast.name: Trustram Greyfell
cast.who: A former company captain famed for a victory remembered as a triumph and whispered as a slaughter.
cast.want: to avoid being taken by strangers

bible.situation: Irvsie hires the company to bring Trustram Greyfell alive to the warden-stones on the ridgeline. Trustram lies hidden after a celebrated but bloody victory and is sheltered by Garalo at a ruined windmill. Garalo will try to keep him from being handed over. The warden-stones are the place named for the delivery.
bible.goal: deliver Trustram Greyfell alive to Irvsie Duskbough at the warden-stones
arc: Reach the warden-stones on the ridgeline Irvsie named to begin the exchange → yields: an old iron hairpin smeared with blood and stamped with a windmill rune
Search the Gullwheel Mill the hairpin points to, using the pin as lead → yields: Garalo, the miller, who admits sheltering Trustram and promises to bring him to the warden-stones
Hold the warden-stones as Garalo promised and present Trustram to Irvsie, beating or bargaining Garalo there to finish the handover
tensions: Garalo will refuse to hand Trustram over and may try to buy his safety.
Forest trails wash out after rain and make pursuit slow and dangerous.
Trustram resists capture and may rally local sympathizers from ridge settlements.
openDirections: Garalo may try to bargain for land or grain for Trustram, or the company may turn Trustram into a bargaining chip with the warders.
bible.stakeIfLost: Irvsie's ridge granary will be seized by the warders when she cannot present Trustram as proof of her pledge.
bible.arrival: came back a second time · would not sit down

shipped.title: Bring the exchange to the warden-stones
shipped.situation: A ridge widow, Irvsie Duskbough, came back a second time and would not sit down. She watches your hands, not your face, and says she must have Trustram Greyfell handed over alive at the warden-stones, the pay is plain coin, and the road's yield goes to the company. She says the warders will seize her ridge granary if she cannot present Trustram as proof of her pledge. A former company captain, Trustram Greyfell, is avoiding strangers and will not hand himself up willingly. A miller intends to hide Trustram in Thornhollow and keep him from being taken.
shipped.job: Reach the warden-stones on the ridgeline Irvsie named to begin the exchange
